events.title: Gin Blending Class
events.description: An interactive one-hour workshop where participants learn about gin and then blend their own unique gin masterpiece from individually distilled botanicals, guided by distillery experts.

events.title: A Bigger View Exhibition
events.description: This exhibition brings together grand-scale masterpieces from the National Gallery of Australia and HOTA's local collection. It's a compelling display for those interested in art, history, and landscape painting.

events.title: SURFACE Festival — Street Art, Murals & Creative Precinct
events.description: Miami and its neighbours transform into a vibrant hub of public art, community events, and live music, featuring over 50 murals, workshops, and street performances throughout July.

events.title: "This Moment" — White Rabbit Collection Exhibition
events.description: An exhibition showcasing 35 contemporary Chinese artworks that explore identity, history, and transformation through large-scale installations, video, photography, painting, and sculpture.

events.title: Jim Jefferies: Son of a Carpenter
events.description: Australian-American comedian Jim Jefferies brings his *Son of a Carpenter* show, featuring razor-sharp storytelling, fearless social commentary, and brazen honesty. Expect a night of classic stand-up driven by personal tales.

events.title: SURFACE Festival
events.location: Miami, Burleigh Heads & Nobby's Beach precincts
events.description: An ongoing festival celebrating street art, music, live events, and workshops, featuring over 50 murals across Miami, Burleigh Heads, and Nobby's Beach. It's an ideal outdoor cultural immersion for creative types to explore on foot or bike.

events.title: The One With All The Questions Trivia
events.description: Join a fun and intellectually stimulating trivia night hosted by QuizzaMe at Currumbin RSL. Gather a team or join one on the night for an evening of questions and conversation.

events.title: FREE Thursday Trivia at Currumbin RSL
events.description: Test your knowledge at this free weekly trivia night hosted by QuizzaMe at Currumbin RSL. A fun, social event perfect for teams or individuals looking for an intellectually engaging evening.

events.title: Grazy Arvo with Koalas
events.description: A special afternoon session at Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary offering close encounters with koalas, complemented by food and drink stalls and a relaxed social atmosphere.

events.title: Scott Bradlee's Postmodern Jukebox — The Future Is Vintage Tour
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: HOTA welcomes the internationally loved vintage-pop phenomenon, known for reworking modern hits into jazz, swing, soul, and retro-inspired arrangements in their new 'The Future is Vintage' tour.

events.title: Free Breakdancing Workshops — Hip Hop Heroes
events.description: The Hip Hop Heroes offer free, all-ages breakdancing workshops daily from 6–11 July. This cultural and movement experience is open to everyone interested in learning hip hop dance.

events.title: 'This Moment' — White Rabbit Collection at HOTA Gallery
events.description: This exhibition gathers 35 artworks from 25 leading contemporary Chinese artists, offering a powerful snapshot of creativity and culture across 21st-century China, with public talks and tours available.

events.title: Tom Gleeson: Out of Touch
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: One of Australia's sharpest comedians, Tom Gleeson, brings his latest stand-up show, 'Out of Touch,' to HOTA for a night of dry wit and no-nonsense comedy.

events.title: Life Drawing with Live Music
events.description: A curated evening of life drawing accompanied by live music, offering an experience for both seasoned artists and those new to the practice.

events.title: Postmodern Jukebox
events.description: An internationally loved vintage-pop phenomenon reimagining modern hits into jazz, swing, soul, and other retro-inspired arrangements.

events.title: Gold Coast TechSpace — Wednesday Hack Night
events.description: A weekly "hack night" for makers and hackers at Gold Coast's community MakerSpace, HackerSpace, and Education Centre, often featuring other tech-focused meetups like Javascript or IoT.

events.title: Gold Coast Board Games Club Meetup
events.description: A social club for adults to play modern board games like Settlers of Catan and Ticket to Ride, fostering interaction and fun within the community.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection
events.description: A major exhibition at HOTA Gallery featuring 35 contemporary artworks from 25 leading Chinese artists, including large-scale installations, video, and sculpture. Offers a rare opportunity to explore one of the world's significant collections of contemporary Chinese art.

events.title: NAIDOC Celebration March
events.description: A meaningful community march from Queen Elizabeth Park to Chris Cunningham Park in Coolangatta, marking NAIDOC Week. Join for a walk through a beautiful coastal area to celebrate Indigenous culture.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart
events.description: A contemporary art exhibition by Aka Sorbie, exploring saltwater Country, heart, and identity through works grounded in coastal and oceanic themes at HOTA Gallery.

events.title: Koi Sunset Sessions
events.description: Ongoing sunset music sessions at Koi Dining & Lounge Bar, featuring DJs or live music in a waterfront lounge setting, with drinks and share plates available.

events.title: Aka Sorbie: Saltwater Heart — Children's Gallery at HOTA
events.description: An immersive children's exhibition by First Nations artist Lisa Sorbie Martin, bringing memories of her Torres Strait childhood to life through ocean-inspired art and interactive play, connecting families with First Nations culture.

events.title: Gold Coast Chamber Orchestra — French & Russian Traditions
events.description: An intimate chamber performance by the Gold Coast Chamber Orchestra at Bond University, celebrating the lyrical beauty and rich colours of French and Russian musical traditions.

events.title: Miami Marketta — Live Music & Street Food Night (Wednesday)
events.description: A vibrant midweek street food and live music market featuring global food vendors, boutique bars, and local musical acts. A casual, social atmosphere perfect for a relaxed evening.

events.title: SURFACE Festival — Street Art & Murals
events.location: Miami, Burleigh Heads & Nobby's Beach precincts
events.description: A festival celebrating street art, music, and creative culture with over 50 murals across Miami, Burleigh Heads, and Nobby's Beach, plus live events and workshops. Great for exploring on foot or bike.

events.title: Tuesday Drag Bingo
events.description: A fierce and fun Tuesday night event combining bingo with drag queen performances and a lively social atmosphere.

events.title: Nightjar Dive Bar — Live Music & DJs
events.datetime: Thu 9 Jul – Sun 12 Jul, 7:00 PM (Thu-Sat), 6:00 PM (Sun)
events.description: A gritty garage dive bar hosting live music and DJ performances with a focus on rock ballads, providing an authentic and intimate atmosphere.

events.title: Flora: Nature's Gift - a BASA Exhibition
events.datetime: Mon 6 Jul - Sun 12 Jul, 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM
events.description: Explore an exhibition by the Botanical Art Society of Australia (BASA) at the RQAS 'Red Wall' Gallery, showcasing various artistic interpretations of nature's flora. A chance to appreciate creative botanical art.

events.title: Emerald Lakes Gourmet Food and Craft Markets
events.description: Explore a vibrant weekly market featuring gourmet food, artisan crafts, and local produce at Emerald Lakes. It's a great opportunity to support local makers and connect with the community.

events.title: Cherry Pickers Market
events.description: Discover a curated selection of vintage, pre-loved, and artisan goods at the Cherry Pickers Market within the creative hub of Miami Marketta. Support local vendors and enjoy a lively community atmosphere.

events.title: HOTA Farmers and Artisan Market
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Surfers Paradise
events.description: Discover fresh produce, artisan goods, and local crafts at the popular HOTA Farmers and Artisan Market. Enjoy the vibrant outdoor atmosphere in the Home of the Arts precinct.

events.title: Sleeping Beauty — The Pantomime
events.description: A family-friendly pantomime at Spotlight Theatre Basement, Benowa, featuring comedy, music, and audience participation, with multiple morning and afternoon sessions running until 11 July.

events.title: Sword Fight VIII — Historical Fencing Tournament
events.location: The Vonda Youngman Community Centre, Tamborine Mountain
events.description: A Historical Fencing (HEMA) tournament showcasing Australia's best fencers in disciplines like Longsword and Rapier, free for spectators, and set in the scenic Gold Coast Hinterland.

events.title: Rumble on the Beach — Skateboarding Championship
events.datetime: Thu 9 – Sun 12 Jul, from 9:00 AM daily
events.location: Elanora Skate Park & Pizzey Park Skatepark, Miami
events.description: A free skateboarding championship event featuring top riders and youth competitions, showcasing genuine skate subculture and action-sport energy across two Gold Coast skateparks.

events.title: NAIDOC Colour Run
events.location: City of Gold Coast Chambers, Surfers Paradise
events.description: A festive, community-spirited NAIDOC Week celebration featuring a free colour run at the City of Gold Coast Chambers, open to all for participation.

events.title: Adventure Day (Outdoor Play & Nature Activities)
events.description: Kids can join outdoor play and nature-based activities at Gibson Park in Tallebudgera Valley, offering a wonderful chance to explore the hinterland and connect with nature.

events.title: Monday Trivia Night
events.description: A weekly trivia night to gather friends and test knowledge, offering a fun and competitive intellectual social event.

events.title: ADHD Expert Panel Discussions and Q&A
events.location: HOTA, Home of the Arts, Bundall
events.description: HOTA hosts a monthly panel discussion and Q&A with ADHD experts, part of their Talks & Ideas series. This event is for those interested in psychology, neurodiversity, and human behavior, offering insights and audience participation.

events.title: HOTA Cinema — Free Screening
events.description: HOTA Cinema offers a free film screening on Tuesday morning, providing a curated, arts-house alternative for film lovers. Multiple other ticketed sessions run daily throughout the week.

events.title: NAIDOC Flag Raising Ceremony
events.description: A significant local community event hosted by Kalwun, celebrating NAIDOC Week with the raising of the Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander flags. This ceremony acknowledges and honours Indigenous culture and history on the Gold Coast.

events.title: Language Exchange at Carrara
events.description: Join a friendly language exchange group at Venture Gold Coast, where you can practice new languages, meet people from diverse backgrounds, and engage in cross-cultural conversations.

events.title: Gold Coast Social and Language Exchange (Make New Friends)
events.description: Join this social and language exchange meetup to practice various languages, meet new people, and expand your social circle in a friendly Gold Coast setting.

events.title: CLOTHES AND TOY SWAP
events.description: Participate in a community clothes and toy swap event, promoting sustainability and resource sharing. A chance to declutter and find new items while connecting with local residents.

events.title: NaturallyGC: Tarrabora Bushcare Tree Planting
events.description: Join the NaturallyGC program for a hands-on bushcare event, participating in tree planting to restore and enhance local natural areas in Tugun. It's an outdoor, community-focused activity.

events.title: This Moment: Highlights from the White Rabbit Collection of Chinese Contemporary Art
events.description: A major exhibition at HOTA Gallery showcasing leading Chinese contemporary artists from the White Rabbit Collection, featuring works in painting, installation, and new media.

events.title: SURFACE Festival – Miami Street Art Program
events.location: Miami streets and laneways (Fence Line Exhibition), Miami
events.description: Part of the SURFACE Festival, this program offers self-guided and hosted walks along the Fence Line Exhibition in Miami, showcasing murals and street art, with additional workshops available.

events.title: Festival of Fun 2026 – Tony Dee Concert Day
events.description: A day within the Festival of Fun featuring a concert by Tony Dee, offering inclusive and accessible entertainment with various activities from 9am and concert doors from midday.

events.title: Christmas in July — D'Arcy Arms Irish Pub
events.location: D'Arcy Arms Irish Pub, Gold Coast
events.description: Gold Coast's historic D'Arcy Arms Irish Pub transforms into a festive wonderland, offering a two-course Christmas in July feast with roast turkey, pork, and ham; pre-booking required.

events.title: Dinomania at Currumbin Wildlife Sanctuary
events.description: Embark on an immersive trail to uncover prehistoric creatures, with daily shows, meet-and-greets, face painting, and craft stations, all included with sanctuary admission.

events.title: Legends of Fleetwood Mac Tribute
events.description: A live tribute performance celebrating the iconic sound and enduring legacy of Fleetwood Mac, held at the Coolangatta Hotel.

events.title: Musical Bingo
events.description: A fun, social, recurring event combining music and bingo, providing an opportunity for casual interaction and entertainment.

events.title: Gold Coast Libraries — Game On! School Holiday Crafts
events.datetime: Mon 6 Jul - Fri 10 Jul, during library hours
events.description: A free, sport-themed craft program running during library hours at various Gold Coast Libraries. This welcoming community event offers a creative outlet for curious minds of all ages.

events.title: ArtLab — Sustainable Textile Art Workshop
events.description: A hands-on workshop at HOTA Gallery where participants create textile art using natural inks and dyes. Explore sustainable art-making in a relaxed and creative environment.

events.title: Festival of Chariots — Chariot Parade
events.description: A vibrant and free Chariot Parade held in Surfers Paradise as part of the Festival of Chariots. This cultural event offers a unique and festive atmosphere for the community.

events.title: Comedy Underground
events.description: A weekly underground comedy night showcasing local and touring stand-up comedians in an intimate, basement-style setting on the Gold Coast.

events.title: Engelbert Humperdinck: The Celebration Tour
events.description: The legendary 'King of Romance' brings his celebration tour to The Star Gold Coast for a night of timeless ballads and classic hits like 'Release Me' and 'The Last Waltz'.

events.title: Eco Arts — Nature-Based Artmaking
events.description: A hands-on, outdoor creative experience where participants, especially kids, can make nature-based artworks using flowers, rocks, and other natural materials in Tallebudgera's Schuster Park.

events.title: Gig Factory
events.description: A live music event at the Coolangatta Hotel, showcasing performances from local and international acts in one of Australia's recognised live entertainment venues.
